display_name: 源域 DURA 噪声统计量区分 clean 与受损场景
description: 按源模拟场景分组检验原 DURA 估计方差与恢复信号能量之比是否能区分 clean 和受损 IQ，不拟合门控。

data.representation: source received IQ and source simulator scene metadata

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Descriptive source AUC and quantiles; no target accuracy or trained gate

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original DURA source provenance verified by frozen_dura
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA and same-contract source-only candidate, subject to completion check
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed DURA v1.0 and fixed 672 source pilot; no target selection

expected_artifacts: result.json source variance-statistic quantiles and clean-vs-scene pair AUC

metric_names: log10 DURA variance over anchor real-IQ mean square

rows.method: Frozen DURA output noise statistic, grouped by source scene; descriptive AUC no fitted threshold
rows.purpose: Test whether a variance-conditioned clean protection hypothesis has source separation
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.

notes: Source simulator scene metadata is used only for retrospective grouping, never as target inference input.
No threshold selected or trained; original DURA may have seen the source domain.
No TX, F, V, target or model updates; source AUC is not identity accuracy.
